description: Header file defining functions for WiFi DFS (Dynamic Frequency Selection) management related to ZW DFS FSM, including initialization, deinitialization, start, and stop operations for a radio context.

methods.name: wifiGen_zwdfs_init
methods.description: Initializes the ZW DFS FSM for the specified radio.

methods.name: wifiGen_zwdfs_deinit
methods.description: Stops and frees all resources related to ZW DFS FSM for the specified radio.

methods.name: wifiGen_zwdfs_start
methods.description: Starts the ZW DFS clearing process for the specified radio, with an option for direct chanspec setting.

methods.name: wifiGen_zwdfs_stop
methods.description: Stops the ZW DFS clearing process for the specified radio.
